comment: Assurance contract for the synthetic agent platform. JSON is valid YAML 1.2; JSON keeps the core stdlib-only.

obligations.statement: Under a persistently failing dependency, no dependency receives more than 3 attempts per run.
A single transient failure of any dependency does not fail the run.
After a 429, the next attempt to that dependency waits at least Retry-After.
Each run executes the irreversible tool action at most once, even when the outcome of a call is ambiguous.
Every side effect and stored record of a run is authorised by a token issued to that run's tenant, including during an identity-provider outage.
If no well-formed LLM response is received, no side effect is executed and the caller gets an error.
Under slow or hanging dependencies the caller gets an answer (result or error) within 1.0 s.
If the platform answers 200, the run's result is in the store.
An expired token is never used, with up to 30 s of clock skew between orchestrator and identity provider.
A failed deployment rolls back to the last healthy revision without dropping in-flight runs.
